title: Vision C is now licensed up to 100 tags
author: Dicot Innovations
excerpt: A smaller, clearer ceiling for our mini-SCADA, and a new path for larger scopes.
content:
Vision C is our Windows mini-SCADA and data logger for compact machines and single lines. Its published ceiling is now up to 100 tags.

What that means

The number is a licence limit, not a technical guess. If your application fits inside 100 tags, Vision C keeps the setup short: Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS, local history, and one-click forwarding to Vision Web.

  • Scope: one compact machine or line.
  • Licences: 2, 5, 10 or 20 years, or perpetual without updates.
  • Quotes: handled through an authorised dealer.

What if the scope is bigger?

For more than 100 tags on-premise, we point you to Vision S, our enterprise SCADA for multi-line and regulated plants. If the need is Vision S-style software at a lower cost, Vision S Lite is in development; register interest and we will share details at launch.

title: Vision S Lite: what we can share today
author: Dicot Innovations
excerpt: A lighter Vision S for cost-sensitive applications. In development, with no invented specs.
content:
Vision S Lite is in development at Dicot. It keeps the Vision S software approach but uses a reduced protocol set and a smaller design library, for plants that need Vision S-style SCADA without the full footprint.

What we can confirm

  • It is built on the Vision S platform.
  • It carries fewer protocols than Vision S.
  • It has a smaller design library.
  • It targets cost-sensitive applications.

What we are not saying yet

We have not published a tag limit, edition list or price. Those will be announced at launch and quoted through authorised dealers. If you want to hear first, register your interest.
